Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays (specifically Figure 1a with arrows) highlight two distinct nodular opacities: one in the right middle lobe silhouetting the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This focal finding, combined with the chronic cough history, aligns best with the description of DIPNECH (Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia), which often presents with mosaic attenuation and nodules, rather than diffuse metastases or a single mass.
